author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
If your Excel reports keep breaking every time you add new data, the problem probably isn’t Excel, it’s how the report is built.

VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP aren’t bad formulas, but they’re the wrong tool for recurring reports. Copying formulas down duplicates data, slows your file, and makes reports harder to maintain.

In this video, I’ll show you the Excel workflow I actually use for reports:
- Keep data in separate tables
- Connect tables using the Excel Data Model
- Build one Pivot Table that updates with a single refresh

No more copying formulas. No more rebuilding reports every month.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
